title: SGE architecture artefact
description: docs/sgd-build/architecture.yaml (SPEC-131): the components a repo is built from, the capabilities each realises and the code paths each lives in. Read with the parser in packages/sge-dashboard/lib/architecture.mjs. The cross-file rules (a capability the model declares, a path that exists, a dependsOn id in the same file, an id no other DAG node uses) are rules A1-A8 of SPEC-131 and SPEC-133, reported as architecture findings. SPEC-133.
